title: Return Policy - Phones, Opened
text:
This policy covers opened phones bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. Opened phones can be sent back within 14 days of the day you received them. A restocking fee of $45 is taken from the refund for each opened phone, because the device has to be inspected, cleaned and repackaged before it can be sold again. The time limit is the same for every colour and storage size, and it counts from the day the phone reached you, not from the day you placed the order.

What to send back

Opened phones must come back in their original box with every item that came with them, such as the charging cable, the power adapter, the SIM tool and the printed guides. Pack the box inside a sturdy shipping carton with enough padding to protect it on the way. Before you pack it, check that no account, tracking service or payment card is still linked to the device, and take out any SIM card or memory card you added. We cannot return cards, cases or accessories left inside the package, and we are not responsible for personal information left on a device that comes back to us. A phone that arrives with a cracked screen, liquid damage or missing parts is not accepted and will be shipped back to you at no cost.

How to start a return

To start a return for opened phones, sign in to your account, go to your order history and choose the phone you want to send back. We email you a prepaid shipping label and a return code to write on the carton, and you can drop the parcel at any shipping point listed on the label. If you prefer, bring the phone to the service desk in any of our stores, where a team member checks it with you and hands you a return slip. Keep the slip or the tracking number until your refund arrives, because it is your record that the phone was sent back in time.

Your refund

Once we have checked the opened phone, we send the refund, less the restocking fee, to the payment method you used. Refunds usually reach your account within a few business days, depending on your bank. Payments made with a gift card are refunded to a gift card, and a payment that was split across several methods is refunded in the same split. If the phone was a gift, the person who received it can ask for store credit instead. We email you as soon as the refund has been sent.

Phones we cannot accept

Opened phones that were reported lost or stolen, or that are locked to an account we cannot remove, are not accepted. Prepaid airtime cards and SIM kits that have been activated cannot be sent back at all, because they are used up the moment they are activated. Screen protectors that have been applied, and phone cases that have been cut or marked, cannot be sent back either.

Exchanges

If you would rather have a different colour or storage size, you can exchange opened phones within the same time limit. An exchange follows the same steps as a return, and we ship the replacement as soon as the original phone has been checked. If the replacement costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we refund the difference to you. Where the phone you want is not available, we tell you straight away and you can choose a refund instead.
